cover.title: Why Drinks Pay Better Than Food
cover.label: DRINKS

lines.text: Restaurants often keep more of each dollar on drinks than food.
lines.say: Restaurants often keep more of each dollar on drinks than food.

lines.text: In September 2026, McDonald's told investors its specialty drinks are high margin.
lines.say: In September twenty twenty-six, McDonald's told investors its specialty drinks are high margin.

scene.headline: McDonald's calls specialty drinks high margin

lines.text: Industry-wide, drinks cost less to make, measured as pour cost: ingredients divided by price.
lines.say: Industry-wide, drinks cost less to make, measured as pour cost: ingredients divided by price.

lines.text: Industry guides say bars aim for 18-24%. Kitchens, 28-35%.
lines.say: Industry guides say bars aim for eighteen to twenty-four percent. Kitchens, twenty-eight to thirty-five.

lines.text: Hypothetical: both cost $12. At 20%, the drink leaves $9.60. At 30%, the burger leaves $8.40.
lines.say: Say both cost twelve dollars. At twenty percent, the drink leaves nine dollars and sixty cents. At thirty percent, the burger leaves eight dollars and forty cents.

lines.text: That's $1.20 more, before staff or rent.
lines.say: That's one dollar and twenty cents more, before staff or rent.

lines.text: Meanwhile, ground beef averaged $6.92 a pound in August 2026.
lines.say: Meanwhile, ground beef averaged six dollars and ninety-two cents a pound in August twenty twenty-six.

scene.title: Ground beef, August price per lb (BLS)

lines.text: In fiscal 2025, Flanigan's liquor stores kept 25.1% after product costs; its restaurants, food and bar combined, kept 66.6%.
lines.say: In fiscal twenty twenty-five, Flanigan's liquor stores kept twenty-five point one percent after product costs; its restaurants, food and bar combined, kept sixty-six point six percent.

lines.text: Drinks usually cost less to make, so menus push them.
lines.say: Drinks usually cost less to make, so menus push them.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Why restaurants keep more of each dollar on drinks than food
post.ig:
Restaurants often keep more of each dollar on drinks than food.
In Sept 2026, McDonald's told investors its specialty drinks are high margin.
Industry guides say bars aim for an 18-24% pour cost; kitchens aim for 28-35% food cost. Hypothetical: a $12 drink at 20% leaves $9.60, a $12 burger at 30% leaves $8.40.
Ground beef averaged $6.92/lb in Aug 2026 (BLS). Flanigan's FY2025 10-K: liquor stores 25.1% gross margin, restaurants (food and bar combined) 66.6%.
Sources: McDonald's Investor Day 2026; BLS average prices; Flanigan's FY2025 10-K; industry pour-cost guides.
